I am pleased to give you a description of the situation of the "European Monetary Union before the start". The economic situation in the euro area and the state of the preparations for the introduction of the euro and the single monetary policy will be the focus of my efforts today's financial year. When the euro is first introduced in 11 Member States of the European Union, the monetary union will begin on a good basis. In a multi-year process with significant progress in the convergence of the economic data of the participating countries, a common basis has been established for the start of the economic and monetary union.
